title: Mastery of Destruction
summary: Defeat enough attackers to expose the Master of Destruction, then finish him.
overview: Defeat enough attackers to expose the Master of Destruction, then finish him.

phases.label: Initial opponents
phases.description: Defeat twenty trial enemies while preserving resources.

phases.label: Master of Destruction
phases.description: Defeat the master before the trial timer expires.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Kill twenty of the trial enemies to activate the master.
Keep the group moving from target to target so the initial enemies do not consume the time budget.
Save enough resources for the master; the entire trial lasts fifteen minutes.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
